I've replied to Dana in our direct message. Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **185 seats**.

That number comes from Dana's own post in #north-team on 2025-08-20. Dana first wrote 180, then corrected it to 185 a few minutes later, and I told them to use 185 in the deck. I couldn't check it against the amendment itself because no Quarrendon contract files are visible in the share. I suggested June Osei-Lark if Dana wants it confirmed against the signed copy.

A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, and Dana is on the account's team, so no approval was needed. I only read channels Dana belongs to.
